def run_demo():
    catalog, lending = build_demo_library()
    past = date.today() - timedelta(days=20)
    late_loan = lending.checkout("M001", "978-0132350884", start_date=past)
    lending.checkout("M002", "978-0201633610")
    print("Inventory:", inventory_summary(catalog))
    print("Overdue:", overdue_report(lending))
    fine = lending.return_book(late_loan.loan_id)
    print(f"Fine charged on return: {fine:.2f}")
    print("Fines:", fines_summary(lending))

def __init__(self, member_id, name, email, membership_type="standard"):
        if not EMAIL_PATTERN.match(email):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid email address: {email}")
        if membership_type not in MEMBERSHIP_LIMITS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown membership type: {membership_type}")
        self.member_id = member_id
        self.name = name
        self.email = email
        self.membership_type = membership_type
        self.active_loans = []
        self.outstanding_fines = 0.0

def add_book(self, isbn, title, author, year, copies=1):
        if isbn in self._books:
            existing = self._books[isbn]
            existing.total_copies += copies
            existing.available_copies += copies
            return existing
        book = Book(isbn, title, author, year, copies)
        self._books[isbn] = book
        return book

def checkout(self, member_id, isbn, start_date=None):
        member = self.members[member_id]
        book = self.catalog.get_book(isbn)
        if not member.can_borrow():
            raise PermissionError(f"Member {member_id} cannot borrow more books")
        if any(loan.book.isbn == isbn for loan in member.active_loans):
            raise PermissionError("Member already has a copy of this book")
        book.checkout_copy()
        loan = Loan(next(self._loan_ids), book, member, start_date)
        member.active_loans.append(loan)
        self.loans[loan.loan_id] = loan
        return loan

def return_book(self, loan_id, returned_on=None):
        loan = self.loans[loan_id]
        if loan.is_returned():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Loan {loan_id} was already returned")
        loan.close(returned_on or date.today())
        loan.book.return_copy()
        loan.member.active_loans.remove(loan)
        fine = calculate_fine(loan)
        if fine > 0:
            loan.member.add_fine(fine)
        return fine
